name: How do you design outdoor kitchens for entertaining flow?

mainEntity.name: How do you design outdoor kitchens for entertaining flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Position serving areas near doors/windows, create multiple prep zones, include warming drawers, and design 36-42" wide paths between counters for smooth guest/host movement.
